contract.domain: direct deterministic evaluation of continuous seasonal environment from immutable P3.4 baseline plus finite time; no cumulative timestep integration
contract.cycle: period_years > 0, finite epoch, continuous global phase in [0,1), exact-integer cycle index within IEEE-754 exact range
contract.waveform: piecewise-linear triangle waveform using only basic arithmetic and floor; no transcendental sin/cos dependency in canonical hashes
contract.spatial_phase: continuous phase shift from P3.4 x/y/altitude relative to P3.4 origin using configurable phase slopes
contract.channel_phase: temperature/moisture/light/nutrients each have nonnegative amplitude and canonical modulo-one phase offset
contract.bounds: seasonal values are clamped to the original P3.4 per-channel bounds; normalized moisture/light/nutrients remain in [0,1]
contract.resource_bridge: current seasonal light/moisture/nutrients map to light/water/nutrients availability and can deterministically scale P3.1 resource supply
contract.resource_mediated_response: test proves seasonal light availability can propagate through existing P3.1 competition into a lower growth_factor without species-name lookup
contract.edge_diagnostics: P3.4 directed topology is preserved and current seasonal channel deltas are recomputed without changing migration decisions
contract.periodicity: environmental patch state repeats after integer cycle periods while absolute time/cycle index remain part of result identity
contract.no_drift: evaluate(t) depends only on P3.4 baseline, time and config; intermediate calls cannot alter later results
contract.rng: kernel consumes no global or simulation RNG
contract.production_boundary: research seasonality only; no production clock authority, persistence ownership, weather events, disturbance scheduling or species-specific phenology table

next_if_passes: accept P3.5, then open P3.6 Disturbance & Succession
observer_note: observer may visualize seasonal phase and current fields only through read-only snapshots; observer never owns canonical time or season state
